joint_angles.left_knee: Angle between the left thigh and left shin, measured at the left knee. Smaller values indicate greater knee flexion.
joint_angles.right_knee: Angle between the right thigh and right shin, measured at the right knee. Smaller values indicate greater knee flexion.
joint_angles.left_hip: Angle between the trunk and the left thigh, measured at the left hip joint. Smaller values indicate greater hip flexion.
joint_angles.right_hip: Angle between the trunk and the right thigh, measured at the right hip joint. Smaller values indicate greater hip flexion.
joint_angles.left_ankle: Angle between the left shin and the left foot, measured at the left ankle joint. Reflects ankle dorsiflexion or plantarflexion.
joint_angles.right_ankle: Angle between the right shin and the right foot, measured at the right ankle joint. Reflects ankle dorsiflexion or plantarflexion.
joint_angles.left_elbow: Angle between the left upper arm and left forearm, measured at the left elbow joint.
joint_angles.right_elbow: Angle between the right upper arm and right forearm, measured at the right elbow joint.
joint_angles.left_shoulder: Angle between the left upper arm and the trunk, measured at the left shoulder joint.
joint_angles.right_shoulder: Angle between the right upper arm and the trunk, measured at the right shoulder joint.
joint_angles.left_wrist: Angle between the left forearm and the left hand, measured at the left wrist joint.
joint_angles.right_wrist: Angle between the right forearm and the right hand, measured at the right wrist joint.

body_angles.trunk_angle_from_vertical: Inclination of the trunk relative to the vertical axis. 0 degrees means the trunk is perfectly upright.
body_angles.left_thigh_angle_from_vertical: Inclination of the left thigh relative to the vertical axis.
body_angles.right_thigh_angle_from_vertical: Inclination of the right thigh relative to the vertical axis.
body_angles.left_shin_angle_from_vertical: Inclination of the left shin relative to the vertical axis.
body_angles.right_shin_angle_from_vertical: Inclination of the right shin relative to the vertical axis.

orientation.trunk: Normalized 3D direction vector of the trunk segment, pointing from the midpoint of the hips toward the midpoint of the shoulders.
orientation.left_upper_arm: Normalized 3D direction vector of the left upper arm, pointing from the left shoulder toward the left elbow.
orientation.right_upper_arm: Normalized 3D direction vector of the right upper arm, pointing from the right shoulder toward the right elbow.
orientation.left_forearm: Normalized 3D direction vector of the left forearm, pointing from the left elbow toward the left wrist.
orientation.right_forearm: Normalized 3D direction vector of the right forearm, pointing from the right elbow toward the right wrist.
orientation.left_thigh: Normalized 3D direction vector of the left thigh, pointing from the left hip toward the left knee.
orientation.right_thigh: Normalized 3D direction vector of the right thigh, pointing from the right hip toward the right knee.
orientation.left_shin: Normalized 3D direction vector of the left shin, pointing from the left knee toward the left ankle.
orientation.right_shin: Normalized 3D direction vector of the right shin, pointing from the right knee toward the right ankle.
